transcript.speaker: Sarah Chen
transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining emergency triage. We are seeing a spike in failed checkout transactions on the Stripe gateway.

transcript.speaker: Alex Rivera
transcript.text: I analyzed the logs from 09:00 UTC. The API timeouts are caused by unindexed queries in the database during high concurrency.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Vance
transcript.text: I think we should immediately roll back the v2.4 deployment to mitigate customer impact.

transcript.speaker: Sarah Chen
transcript.text: I strongly disagree with rolling back v2.4 because it contains critical security updates.

transcript.speaker: Alex Rivera
transcript.text: We decided to deploy the missing database index migration to production immediately instead of rolling back.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Vance
transcript.text: Marcus Vance will run the database index migration script by 11:30 AM today.

transcript.speaker: Sarah Chen
transcript.text: There is a risk that running concurrent index creation on the active primary DB could cause brief locks.
